name: Design Gate — UI spec, tokens, mockups, adversarial review
description: Fires when a [design] card completes. The designer runs a loop_engine converge cycle producing the four design artifacts (component-system choice, UI spec + wireframes, design tokens, HTML mockups), each revision verified by an adversarial design review (state coverage, a11y, consistency, spec traceability). PASS closes the [design-done] gate, which holds every UI ticket of the project.

nodes.body_template:
## Design cycle — produce and prove the four design artifacts

**Project:** ${trigger.title}
**Design card:** ${trigger.card_body}

The [design] card body contains a line `DESIGN GATE: <card-id>` — that gate holds every UI ticket of this project until it closes. It also names the repo path and the stamped spec file.

You are the designer. Load your `ui-design` skill. Run the design work as a loop_engine converge cycle — the same discipline decompose uses.

### Call loop_engine with

- `goal`: "Prove the design for: ${trigger.title}"
- `runner`: "designer"
- `max_iterations`: 3
- `execution`: {
    title: "[design-exec] Produce design artifacts",
    body: "Load the ui-design skill. Work in the project repo (path from the design card body). Produce ALL FOUR layers, in order — each constrains the next:\n1. COMPONENT SYSTEM — read ~/.hermes-teams/startup/tech-preferences.json (tailwind + the matching ui-library for the architect's tech stack). Record the choice + why in docs/ui-spec.md.\n2. UI SPEC + WIREFRAMES — docs/ui-spec.md: every screen with ASCII/mermaid wireframes; for EVERY screen: empty state, error state, loading state (if async); user flows between screens; every user story in the spec maps to at least one screen (traceability table).\n3. DESIGN TOKENS — design-tokens.json at repo root: colors, spacing scale, type scale, radii — mostly INHERITED from the chosen system, customized only where the spec demands (e.g. brand color).\n4. HTML MOCKUPS — docs/mockups/<screen>.html per screen: static HTML using inline styles derived STRICTLY from design-tokens.json (the real components come at build time; mockups approximate with tokens so they render offline). Verify each renders: playwright screenshot each mockup to docs/mockups/<screen>.png.",
    assignee: "designer",
    skill: "ui-design"
  }
- `verifier`: {
    title: "[design-review] Adversarial design review",
    body: "You are adversarially reviewing design artifacts in the project repo. Read docs/ui-spec.md, design-tokens.json, docs/mockups/*.html and the original stamped spec. Fan out via kanban_chains one reviewer card per probe, then synthesize:\n1. STATE COVERAGE — every screen has empty/error/loading states designed. Missing state = finding.\n2. A11Y — contrast basics (WCAG AA text), focus order described, text alternatives for any imagery, semantic headings.\n3. CONSISTENCY — mockup inline styles actually derive from design-tokens.json values (drift = finding); tokens actually inherit from the chosen component system.\n4. SPEC TRACEABILITY — every user story ↔ screen mapping exists BOTH ways; orphan screens = scope creep finding.\nAlso screenshot each mockup with playwright and confirm it renders without errors (blank page = Critical).\nComplete with metadata dod_verdict: {dod_met: true|false, recommendation: \"advance\"|\"replan\", gaps: [specific gaps]}",
    assignee: "verifier",
    metric_type: "ground_truth"
  }

### On every promotion

Re-call loop_engine with the SAME parameters. Do not read verdicts yourself. On advance: complete this card with metadata {designed: true, system: "<chosen>", ui_spec: "<path>", tokens: "<path>", mockups: N, gate: "<DESIGN GATE id>", converged: true, iterations: N}.

Do NOT complete the DESIGN GATE card yourself — the next node owns that.

## Close the design gate

**Project:** ${trigger.title}
**Design gate:** ${nodes.design-cycle.output.gate}

The design cycle converged (adversarial review PASSED). The design card body contains a line `DESIGN GATE: <card-id>`.

Run the CLI form (NOT the kanban_complete tool — the gate card belongs to the workflow-gate control lane; the CLI is the orchestrator path):

```
hermes kanban --board ${trigger.board} complete <gate-id> --result "design approved: ${nodes.design-cycle.output.system}, ${nodes.design-cycle.output.mockups} mockups verified"
```

If the CLI reports the gate already done, treat as success. Closing the gate releases every UI ticket held by the design barrier.

**Completion metadata:**
```
{gate_closed: true|false, gate_id: "<id>"}
```
